units.source_text: 但是，他活动的手具有残酷的成分。

en.t: But there was something cruel in the movement of his hands.

units.source_text: 他拥有不快而阴暗的特权似地对植物动作。

en.t: He handled the plants as though he possessed some unpleasant, gloomy privilege over them.

units.source_text: 不知是不是由于这个缘故，每次剪刀一响，将花茎剪下来的时候，我仿佛看到了满满的血。

en.t: Perhaps because of that, whenever the scissors clicked and cut through a flower stem, I seemed to see it filled with blood.
